name: Omi
summary: An always-listening personal AI that captures conversations and your screen, turning them into summaries, action items and searchable memory, with an optional pendant.

claims.value: Captures conversations and screen context continuously and turns them into summaries, action items and searchable memory across phone, desktop and an optional pendant
The desktop app reads the screen; driving a browser or desktop is not described
claims.shortValue: Reads your screen, does not drive

claims.value: Continuous listening and transcription is the core of the product, with on-phone transcription on the free plan
Capture is continuous and summarising automatic, but no scheduled or event-triggered autonomy is described for the user's own agent
Native macOS and Windows desktop apps
Native iOS and Android apps, plus an Apple Watch app
iPhone, Android, Apple Watch, macOS, Windows and the web
The hosted backend names Soniox for speech recognition; the language model providers are not disclosed
Bringing your own key is possible only by self-hosting the backend; no local model mode is described for the consumer app
Free plan included with every device; Pro is a standalone subscription

Free plan with unlimited on-phone transcription and 300 cloud minutes a month; Pro US$269 a year. The pendant is US$179 with a US$50 discount applied at checkout, and a glasses developer kit is US$499
Apps on your own devices talking to a hosted backend, with the whole backend self-hostable from the repository
A public developer API with bearer keys covering memories, conversations and action items, rate limited per key and per user, plus an MCP server
Conversations, transcripts, summaries, action items and remembered facts, preferences and relationships persist and are searchable
A copy of personal data can be requested by email; no self-serve export is described, though the developer API can read your own conversations and memories
claims.shortValue: On request; API reads own data

claims.value: Deleting a conversation deletes its transcript and associated data including stored audio
Open sign-up with free apps on every platform; the device ships worldwide

platforms.detail: Native iOS app on the App Store.
Native Android app on Google Play.

access.detail: Open sign-up; free apps on every platform and the device ships worldwide.

onYourComputer.detail: The desktop app reads the screen for context but does not drive applications.

whileYouAreOff.detail: Screen capture ends when the computer does, while the phone or the optional pendant keeps listening and the hosted backend keeps summarising.

worksWithoutVendor.detail: MIT-licensed with a self-hostable backend, so a technical owner could keep it running, though the consumer apps point at the hosted service by default.

dataAfterExit.detail: A copy of personal data can be requested by email; the developer API can also read your own conversations and memories.

plans.name: Pro
limits: A monthly price is implied but not published

cost.note: free plan with every device; Pro is US$269 a year

hardware.name: Omi pendant
hardware.detail: A US$179 pendant discounted to US$129 at checkout, with ten to fourteen hours of battery, shipping worldwide; a glasses developer kit is US$499. Neither is required, since the free plan works with phone-only transcription, and the hardware designs are open source.

launches.label: Repository first published, under the earlier name Friend

newsSource.note: Checked: the blog carries auto-generated marketing content and no dated product updates
